name: ai-architect-rules
description: The architecture judgement layer for building with Claude: 38 decision rules behind the Claude Certified Architect - Professional blueprint (agents, tools and credentials, MCP, RAG, evals, human review, guardrails, compliance data flows, model tier, caching, SLAs, Claude Code team setup), each with the deciding cue, the right call and the tempting wrong call. A rules skill that answers design questions, a review skill that gates plans and workflows, a prompt hook that makes the rules fire while you build, and an 85-term vocabulary for non-developers.
